answer: A workable design: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the wander to sunk effort, uses the timber as an corroborating signal, then requires a prism before any payout.
